candidates.title: ASTER: Adaptive Dynamic Layer-Skipping for Efficient Transformer Inference via Markov Decision Process
candidates.abstract: Transformer-based models have demonstrated remarkable performance in computer vision tasks. However, their increasing model size leads to substantial memory demands and higher latency, hindering practical deployment. This paper presents an adaptive dynamic layer-skipping framework based on Markov Decision Process, which determines optimal computational paths based on the current state of input samples. We introduce a Temporal Importance Difference Reward mechanism to address the credit assignment problem in layer-skipping decisions, and develop a knowledge distillation strategy using learnable cognitive tokens to compensate for information loss. Experiments on various models demonstrate that our method significantly reduces computational costs while maintaining accuracy, offering a practical solution for deploying high-performance Transformer models in resource-constrained environments. The code is available at https://github.com/wjjkhl/ASTER
candidates.reason: ACM Multimedia 2025公式採択一覧で同一題名・著者を確認し、著者所属の上海期智研究院が2025-11-14に公開した研究成果概要を一次資料として照合。ASTERはTransformer推論でマルコフ決定過程による入力依存の層スキップを行い、Temporal Importance Difference Rewardに対応する逐次判断と学習可能なcognitive tokensを用いる知識蒸留補償で省略層の情報損失を抑える。研究機関はViT、DeiTだけでなくLLaMA、DistilBERTでも検証したと明記するため、画像専用の枝刈り論文ではなくLLM推論の条件付き計算にも直接適用される。よってaccept。DeiTでの理論3倍高速化時43.68%精度という数値は著者機関の報告値であり、LLM実機の速度倍率とは扱わない。出版社原著PDF/abstractはアクセス制限のため未直接閲覧、Research段階で原著全文とモデル別結果を再確認する。
